title: UAV Scenario Motion Read
source_docs: UAV Toolbox/UAV Scenario and Sensor Modeling/UAV_Scenario_Motion_Read.md
text: Read platform and sensor motions from UAV scenario simulation, 3 outputs, {Coordinate frame of output motion} sets Coordinate frame of output motion; {Platform or sensor name} and {Generate wind velocity and angular velocity samples} sets the generate wind velocity and angular velocities. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: SampledWind
ports.summary: Resultant wind translational and angular velocity 1-by-6 vector

ports.name: SampledWindByComponent
ports.summary: Wind translational and angular velocities from each wind model objects N -by-6 matrix

params.name: Coordinate frame of output motion
params.values: Coordinate frame of output motion ’ENU’ (default) | ’NED’ | string

params.name: Generate wind velocity and angular velocity samples
params.values: Generate wind velocity and angular velocities samples off (default) | on
